dedupe_keys.name: southern china coastal land cover reference samples

description: This Science Data Bank collection publishes labelled coastal land-cover samples for southern China. The initial release contains 16,444 points across ten classes, including 1,887 mangrove and 2,205 artificial impervious-surface samples. Later versions add ten Shapefile validation sets, each containing 600 mangrove and 600 non-mangrove samples, with additional near-water vegetation classes. Public downloads are free under CC-BY-4.0. The samples can train or evaluate land-cover classifiers used to create coastal exposure and green-infrastructure inputs for simulation. They complement the associated mangrove maps by supplying reference labels, not classified coverage alone. Sample selection is based on imagery and is not a uniform probability sample of the entire coast. Dates and class definitions vary between subsets, and repeated validation sets should not be assumed independent. The provider’s stated coverage includes Hong Kong, Macau and Taiwan. No sample files were inspected, so attribute names and coordinate reference details remain to be checked before combining the subsets.
